reviews.Author: Lyn Almaguer
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on April 10, 2026
reviews.Text: If you’re looking for a cleaner, more natural salt, Redmond Real Salt is honestly one of the best choices out there. Unlike heavily processed table salt, this mineral salt is unrefined and contains trace minerals that give it a richer, more balanced flavor. You can actually taste the difference, it’s not as harsh or overly salty, just smooth and full-bodied. One of the biggest reasons to switch is purity. Redmond salt is mined in the U.S. and doesn’t go through chemical processing or bleaching, so what you’re getting is real, natural salt straight from the earth. No additives, no anti-caking agents just simple, clean ingredients. It’s also incredibly versatile. Whether you’re cooking, baking, or just sprinkling a little on top of your food, it enhances flavor without overpowering it. A little goes a long way, and it elevates even the simplest meals. If you care about what goes into your body and want a more natural alternative to regular salt, this is absolutely worth it. Once you switch, it’s hard to go back.
reviews.Title: MUST BUY!!!!!!

reviews.Author: Michael Gibbs
reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on September 7, 2026
reviews.Text: Great salt with a clean flavor and a fine texture that spreads evenly. I use it on steaks, ground beef, eggs, and nearly everything else that once had a pulse. The resealable pouch is convenient, although mine rarely stays sealed for long. It is simple, tastes great, and contains no unnecessary ingredients. At this point, Redmond Real Salt is less of a seasoning and more of a food group in my house.
